items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This is a funny but interesting band: Randy Brecker, Barry Rogers, Dave Taylor, Tom Malone, you, Sato, Ryo Kawasaki, Francisco Santino on bass, and Harvey Mason on drums.

ctx.x: I don’t remember it really, except that’s one of those Japanese combinations.
This is a funny but interesting band: Randy Brecker, Barry Rogers, Dave Taylor, Tom Malone, you, Sato, Ryo Kawasaki, Francisco Santino on bass, and Harvey Mason on drums.
That’s a commercial fusion record. That’s an absolute fusion record.
